plugins.name: github-labels-plugin
plugins.description: Set up structured GitHub issue labels for any repository — priority, clarity, risk, blast radius, size, parallelism, sequencing, and type

plugins.name: swift-accessibility-plugin
plugins.description: Audit and fix SwiftUI accessibility for VoiceOver, XCUITest and AI agents — including the modifiers that silently remove accessibility, and the Dynamic Type, contrast and Reduce Motion checks a modifier pass alone misses

plugins.name: liquid-glass-plugin
plugins.description: Implement iOS 26 Liquid Glass effects in SwiftUI and UIKit — API reference, design rules, and code patterns

plugins.name: sonos-cli-plugin
plugins.description: Control Sonos speakers from the CLI — playback, volume, grouping, queue management, and music search

plugins.name: openhue-plugin
plugins.description: Control Philips Hue lights from the CLI — brightness, color, scenes, and automation via openhue

plugins.name: and-then-plugin
plugins.description: Ambiguity-first planning — identify and resolve unknowns before committing to a plan

plugins.name: team-work-plugin
plugins.description: Decompose a session's JTBD into a parallelizable agent-team plan — tiered models, specialist subagents, dependency waves

plugins.name: code-review-plugin
plugins.description: Review code against a style guide focused on progressive disclosure, explicit contracts, agentic patterns, and token economics — severity-grouped findings with file:line refs and concrete fixes

plugins.name: spec-speak-plugin
plugins.description: Convert rough subject matter into rigorous, testable specs — EARS requirement templates, RFC 2119 keywords, INCOSE/ISO 29148 rules, Gherkin acceptance criteria, zone-aware strictness

plugins.name: ios-aso-plugin
plugins.description: Generate paste-ready English (U.S.) App Store Optimization metadata (ASO.md) for an iOS app by scanning its Swift/SwiftUI codebase — App Name, Subtitle, Keywords, Promotional Text, Description, category, screenshot captions, IAP names, and research notes

plugins.name: claude-md-kit-plugin
plugins.description: Composable, stack-agnostic prompt segments for CLAUDE.md — copy-paste modules, or let the skill assemble a project CLAUDE.md from them
